name: auth
title: Auth pages + role guard
description: Completes the scaffold's login: a sign-up page (form() with validation, password confirmation and server errors), a role-protected admin folder (_guard.jsbrain: anonymous → login with ?next=, signed in without the role → 403 naming the missing role) and a session status component (sign-in link or the user and a sign-out button). server/auth.jsbrain gains a role and a demo register().
notes: The demo provider exists only while DEMO_PASSWORD is set ([development] in .brain_env); replace check() and register() with a real provider. In the demo an email starting with admin@ gets the admin role.
